stores.note: Denim-heavy Japanese workwear shop. Double Nep jeans had only size 36 in stock when checked (sizes 38+ list at $475).
stores.vibe: A SoHo institution for Japanese selvedge denim and heritage workwear (Pure Blue Japan, Kapital, Fullcount, Samurai) that also carries store-exclusive fits and artisan-made one-offs.

stores.vibe: The Garment District home of Engineered Garments and Needles: Americana, military and ivy staples reworked with odd patterns, pocket-heavy details and a lot of flannel, corduroy and moleskin.
